akhfash:1-3.t: He said ﴿ الۤـمۤ [1] غُلِبَتِ ٱلرُّومُ﴾ ﴿وَهُم مِّن بَعْدِ غَلَبِهِمْ سَيَغْلِبُونَ﴾, i.e. after they had been defeated. Some read ﴿غَلَبَتْ﴾ and ﴿سيُغْلَبُون﴾, because when Islam came they had been victorious, and then they were defeated when Islam spread.

akhfash:4-4.t: And He said ﴿مِن قَبْلُ وَمِن بَعْدُ﴾: (with the ending) ḍamma, because "قَبْلُ" and "بَعْدُ" take ḍamma as long as you do not annex them, since they are not fully declinable; when you annex them they become declinable.

akhfash:10-10.t: And He said ﴿أَسَاءُواْ ٱلسُّوۤءَىٰ﴾: "السُّوأَى" here is its maṣdar (verbal noun), like "التَقْوَى" (piety).

akhfash:24-24.t:
[And He said] ﴿وَمِنْ آيَاتِهِ يُرِيكُمُ ٱلْبَرْقَ خَوْفاً وَطَمَعاً﴾: He did not mention ﴿أَنْ﴾ in it because this indicates the meaning. The poet said [in the ṭawīl metre; this is poetic witness no. 107]:
ألاَ أيُّهذا الزاَّجِرِي أحْضِر الوغى * وأنْ أشْهَدَ اللَذَّاتِ هَلْ أَنْتَ مُخْلِدِي
(O you who chide me for attending battle and for witnessing pleasures — can you make me live forever?)
He meant: "أنْ إَحْضُرَ الوَغَى" (that I attend battle).

akhfash:30-30.t: And He said ﴿فِطْرَتَ ٱللَّهِ﴾: he put it in the accusative by the verb, as though He said "Allah created that as a creation (fiṭra)".

akhfash:31-31.t: And He said ﴿مُنِيبِينَ﴾ as a ḥāl (circumstantial), because when He said ﴿فَأَقِمْ وَجْهَكَ﴾ He had commanded him and his people, so that it is as though He said "set your faces, turning in repentance".

akhfash:34-34.t: And He said ﴿لِيَكْفُرُواْ بِمَآ آتَيْنَاهُمْ فَتَمَتَّعُواْ﴾: its meaning — and Allah knows best — is "they did that in order to be ungrateful". Then He turned to them and said "enjoy yourselves", ﴿فَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ﴾. Some read ﴿فَتَمَتَّعُوا فسوف يَعْلَمونَ﴾, as though it were "they have enjoyed themselves, and they will come to know".

akhfash:36-36.t: And He said ﴿وَإِن تُصِبْهُمْ سَيِّئَةٌ إِذَا هُمْ يَقْنَطُونَ﴾: His word ﴿إِذَا هُمْ يَقْنَطُونَ﴾ is the answer (apodosis), because "إِذا" is attached to the first part of the speech, equivalent to the fāʾ.

akhfash:49-49.t: And He said ﴿وَإِن كَانُواْ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يُنَزَّلَ عَلَيْهِمْ مِّن قَبْلِهِ لَمُبْلِسِينَ﴾: He repeated ﴿مِّن قَبْلِهِ﴾ for tawkīd (emphasis), as in ﴿فَسَجَدَ ٱلْمَلاۤئِكَةُ كُلُّهُمْ أَجْمَعُونَ﴾.

daas-irab:47-47.t:
[Translator's note: in the source text of this entry the opening brackets and the first letters of most Quranic words are garbled (e.g. «َ لَقَدْ», «َ رْسَلْنا», «ِ نْ قَبْلِكَ»). The words are restored below from the verse in ﴿…﴾; the analyses are translated as written.]
﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾ The wāw is a particle of oath and genitive; the lām is the lām of the oath; ﴿قد﴾ is a particle of verification (taḥqīq). ﴿أَرْسَلْنا﴾ A past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِكَ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿رُسُلًا﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿إِلى قَوْمِهِمْ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb as well; the clause is the answer to the oath and has no grammatical position. ﴿فَجاؤُهُمْ﴾ The fāʾ is a conjunction, then a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿بِالْبَيِّناتِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿فَانْتَقَمْنا﴾ The fāʾ is a conjunction, then a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿مِنَ الَّذِينَ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿أَجْرَمُوا﴾ A past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين. ﴿وَكانَ﴾ The wāw is a conjunction, then a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿حَقًّا﴾ Its khabar (predicate), placed first. ﴿عَلَيْنا﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to حقا. ﴿نَصْرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ The ism of kāna, placed after, annexed to المؤمنين; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:48-48.t:
﴿اللَّهُ الَّذِي﴾ The Divine Name is the mubtadaʾ (subject) and the relative noun is its khabar (predicate); the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa) and has no grammatical position. ﴿يُرْسِلُ﴾ An imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿الرِّياحَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿فَتُثِيرُ﴾ An imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿سَحاباً﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿فَيَبْسُطُهُ﴾ An imperfect verb and its mafʿūl, and the fāʿil is latent. ﴿فِي السَّماءِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿كَيْفَ﴾ An interrogative noun in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿يَشاءُ﴾ An imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is a ḥāl.
﴿وَيَجْعَلُهُ﴾ An imperfect verb and its first mafʿūl, and the fāʿil is latent. ﴿كِسَفاً﴾ Second mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.
﴿فَتَرَى﴾ An imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿الْوَدْقَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿يَخْرُجُ﴾ An imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿مِنْ خِلالِهِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb; the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿فَإِذا﴾ The fāʾ is a resumptive particle. ﴿إذا أَصابَ﴾ [إذا is] a non-jussive conditional adverb (ẓarfiyya sharṭiyya ghayr jāzima), and a past verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿بِهِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿مِنْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿يَشاءُ﴾ An imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿مِنْ عِبادِهِ﴾ ḥāl. ﴿إِذا﴾ [the iḏā] of surprise (fujāʾiyya). ﴿هُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ﴾ An imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil; the verbal clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:49-49.t: ﴿وَإِنْ﴾ The wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). ﴿إِنْ﴾ lightened from the heavy [inna] (mukhaffafa min al-thaqīla), inoperative (muhmala). ﴿كانُوا﴾ kāna and its ism. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) مبلسين. ﴿أَنْ يُنَزَّلَ﴾ A passive imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by أن, and its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent (mustatir); the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from أن and the verb is in the position of genitive by annexation. ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِهِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb ينزل. ﴿لَمُبْلِسِينَ﴾ The lām is the distinguishing lām (al-lām al-fāriqa). ﴿مبلسين﴾ The khabar (predicate) of كانوا; and the clause إن كانوا.. is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:50-50.t: ﴿فَانْظُرْ﴾ The fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and an imperative verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿إِلى آثارِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿رَحْمَتِ اللَّهِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the Divine Name is likewise a muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿كَيْفَ﴾ An interrogative noun in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿يُحْيِ﴾ An imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿الْأَرْضَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿بَعْدَ مَوْتِها﴾ An adverb of time annexed to موتها. ﴿إِنَّ ذلِكَ﴾ inna and its ism. ﴿لَمُحْيِ﴾ The shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa). ﴿محيي﴾ Its khabar (predicate). ﴿الْمَوْتى﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿وَهُوَ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿عَلى كُلِّ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the khabar قدير. ﴿شَيْءٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿قَدِيرٌ﴾ khabar.

daas-irab:51-51.t: ﴿وَلَئِنْ﴾ The wāw is a resumptive particle, and the lām is the one preparing for an omitted oath (mawṭiʾa li-l-qasam). And ﴿إن﴾ is a jussive conditional particle. ﴿أَرْسَلْنا﴾ A past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿رِيحاً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya) and has no grammatical position. ﴿فَرَأَوْهُ﴾ The fāʾ is a conjunction, then a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl. ﴿مُصْفَرًّا﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. The lām falls in the answer of the oath. ﴿لَظَلُّوا﴾ A defective (nāqiṣ) past verb and its ism. ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِهِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) what follows them. ﴿يَكْفُرُونَ﴾ An imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of ظلوا. The clause لظلوا.. is the answer to the oath, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted because the answer to the oath indicates it.

daas-irab:52-52.t: ﴿فَإِنَّكَ﴾ The fāʾ is a particle of causation (taʿlīl), and inna and its ism. ﴿لا تُسْمِعُ﴾ [lā is] negating, and an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿الْمَوْتى﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of inna, and the nominal clause is a causation (taʿlīl). ﴿وَلا تُسْمِعُ﴾ The clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿الصُّمَّ﴾ First mafʿūl bihi. ﴿الدُّعاءَ﴾ Second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿إِذا﴾ An adverb of time. ﴿وَلَّوْا﴾ A past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿مُدْبِرِينَ﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation.

daas-irab:53-53.t: ﴿وَما﴾ The wāw is a resumptive particle. ﴿ما﴾ negating, operating like laysa. ﴿أَنْتَ﴾ The ism of mā. ﴿بِهادِ﴾ The bāʾ is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. ﴿هادي﴾ genitive (majrūr) in form, accusative (manṣūb) in position, the khabar (predicate) of mā. ﴿الْعُمْيِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿عَنْ ضَلالَتِهِمْ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) العمي. ﴿إِنْ﴾ negating. ﴿تُسْمِعُ﴾ An imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿إِلَّا﴾ A particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿مَنْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿يُؤْمِنُ﴾ An imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿بِآياتِنا﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of من. ﴿فَهُمْ مُسْلِمُونَ﴾ The fāʾ is a conjunction, and a mubtadaʾ (subject) and its khabar; the nominal clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:54-54.t: ﴿اللَّهُ الَّذِي﴾ The Divine Name is the mubtadaʾ (subject) and the relative noun is its khabar (predicate); the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿خَلَقَكُمْ﴾ A past verb and its mafʿūl (object), and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿مِنْ ضَعْفٍ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذي. ﴿ثُمَّ جَعَلَ﴾ A conjunction, and a past verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿ضَعْفٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿قُوَّةً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ A conjunction. ﴿جَعَلَ﴾ A past verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿قُوَّةً﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿ضَعْفاً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَشَيْبَةً﴾ maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿يَخْلُقُ﴾ An imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿ما﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿يَشاءُ﴾ An imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَهُوَ الْعَلِيمُ الْقَدِيرُ﴾ A mubtadaʾ and two khabars; the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:55-55.t: ﴿وَ﴾ The wāw is a resumptive particle. ﴿يَوْمَ﴾ An adverb of time. ﴿تَقُومُ السَّاعَةُ﴾ An imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation. ﴿يُقْسِمُ الْمُجْرِمُونَ﴾ An imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿ما لَبِثُوا﴾ [mā is] negating, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the answer to the oath. ﴿غَيْرَ ساعَةٍ﴾ An adverb of time annexed to ساعة. ﴿كَذلِكَ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) [an omitted] adjective (ṣifa) of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿كانُوا﴾ kāna and its ism. ﴿يُؤْفَكُونَ﴾ A passive imperfect verb, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is the khabar (predicate) of كانوا, and the clause كذلك.. is resumptive and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:56-56.t:
﴿وَ﴾ The wāw is a conjunction. ﴿قالَ الَّذِينَ﴾ A past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿أُوتُوا﴾ A passive past verb, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿الْعِلْمَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَالْإِيمانَ﴾ Conjoined to العلم; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين.
The lām falls in the answer to an omitted oath. ﴿قد﴾ A particle of verification (taḥqīq). ﴿لَبِثْتُمْ﴾ A past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿فِي كِتابِ اللَّهِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb, and the Divine Name is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿إِلى يَوْمِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿الْبَعْثِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is the answer to an implied (muqaddar) oath. ﴿فَهذا﴾ The fāʾ falls in the apodosis of an implied condition. ﴿هذا يَوْمِ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject) and its khabar (predicate); the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿الْبَعْثِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; the conditional clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿وَلكِنَّكُمْ﴾ The wāw is a conjunction, and lākinna and its ism. ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾ A defective (nāqiṣ) past verb and its ism. ﴿لا تَعْلَمُونَ﴾ [lā is] negating, and an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil; the verbal clause is the khabar of كنتم. The clause لكنكم.. is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:57-57.t: ﴿فَيَوْمَئِذٍ﴾ The fāʾ is a conjunction. ﴿يومئذ﴾ An adverb of time annexed to its like [i.e. to إذ]. ﴿لا يَنْفَعُ﴾ [lā is] negating, and an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is conjoined to the clause لقد لبثتم.. ﴿ظَلَمُوا﴾ A past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين. ﴿مَعْذِرَتُهُمْ﴾ The fāʿil of ينفع. ﴿وَ﴾ The wāw is a conjunction. ﴿لا﴾ negating. ﴿هُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿يُسْتَعْتَبُونَ﴾ A passive imperfect verb, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:58-58.t: ﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾ The wāw is a particle of oath and genitive, and the lām falls in the answer to the oath, the thing sworn by being omitted; qad is a particle of verification (taḥqīq). ﴿ضَرَبْنا﴾ A past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿لِلنَّاسِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the clause is the answer to the oath and has no grammatical position. ﴿فِي هذَا﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿الْقُرْآنِ﴾ badal (substitute) for the demonstrative. ﴿مِنْ كُلِّ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ضربنا. ﴿مَثَلٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَلَئِنْ﴾ The wāw is a conjunction, and the lām is the one preparing for an omitted oath (mawṭiʾa li-l-qasam). ﴿إِنْ﴾ conditional. ﴿جِئْتَهُمْ﴾ A past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya) and has no grammatical position. ﴿بِآيَةٍ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿لَيَقُولَنَّ﴾ The lām falls in the answer to the implied (muqaddar) oath. ﴿يقولن﴾ An imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is attached to the heavy nūn of emphasis; the clause is the answer to the implied oath and has no grammatical position. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾ A past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿إِنْ﴾ negating. ﴿أَنْتُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿إِلَّا﴾ A particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿مُبْطِلُونَ﴾ The khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ; the nominal clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).

daas-irab:59-59.t: ﴿كَذلِكَ﴾ The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿يَطْبَعُ اللَّهُ﴾ An imperfect verb, and the Divine Name is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿عَلى قُلُوبِ الَّذِينَ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb, and the relative noun is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿لا يَعْلَمُونَ﴾ [lā is] negating, and an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause).

daas-irab:60-60.t: ﴿فَاصْبِرْ﴾ The fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa, and an imperative verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is the apodosis of an implied condition and has no grammatical position. ﴿إِنَّ وَعْدَ اللَّهِ﴾ inna and its ism, annexed to the Divine Name. ﴿حَقٌّ﴾ The khabar (predicate) of inna; the clause is a causation (taʿlīl) and has no grammatical position. ﴿وَلا يَسْتَخِفَّنَّكَ﴾ The wāw is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is attached to the heavy nūn of emphasis, in the position of jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive lā; the kāf is its mafʿūl (object). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to the clause اصبر.. and has no grammatical position. ﴿لا يُوقِنُونَ﴾ lā is negating, and an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين.

daas-irab:1-2.t: ﴿الم﴾ letters with no grammatical position. ﴿غُلِبَتِ﴾ a passive past verb. ﴿الرُّومُ﴾ nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:10-10.t: ﴿ثُمَّ كانَ﴾ «ثم» is a conjunction, and a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿عاقِبَةَ﴾ the fronted khabar (predicate) of «كان». ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿أَساؤُا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of «الذين». ﴿السُّواى﴾ the delayed noun of «كان»; the clause «كان..» is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿أَنْ﴾ maṣdarī (infinitival). ﴿كَذَّبُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from «أن» and the verb is a badal (substitute) of «السوأى». ﴿بِآياتِ اللَّهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb, and the Divine Name is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿كانُوا﴾ «كان» and its noun. ﴿بِها﴾ attached to what comes after them. ﴿يَسْتَهْزِؤُنَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of «كانوا», and the clause «كانوا..» is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:11-11.t: ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Divine Name, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿يَبْدَؤُا﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿الْخَلْقَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿يُعِيدُهُ﴾ an imperfect verb and its object, and the fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿إِلَيْهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to what comes after them. ﴿تُرْجَعُونَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:12-12.t: ﴿وَ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle. ﴿يَوْمَ﴾ an adverb of time. ﴿تَقُومُ السَّاعَةُ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). And ﴿يُبْلِسُ الْمُجْرِمُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:13-13.t: ﴿وَلَمْ يَكُنْ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by «لم». ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ the fronted khabar (predicate) of «يكن». ﴿مِنْ شُرَكائِهِمْ﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿شُفَعاءُ﴾ the delayed noun of «يكن»; the clause is resumptive. And the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿كانُوا﴾ «كان» and its noun. ﴿بِشُرَكائِهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to the khabar of «كانوا», ﴿كافِرِينَ﴾; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:14-14.t: ﴿وَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿يَوْمَ﴾ an adverb of time. ﴿تَقُومُ السَّاعَةُ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿يَوْمَئِذٍ﴾ verbal tawkīd (emphasis by repetition) of what precedes it. ﴿يَتَفَرَّقُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:15-15.t: ﴿فَأَمَّا﴾ the fāʾ is a resumptive particle; ﴿أما﴾ a particle of condition and detailing (tafṣīl). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is a ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَعَمِلُوا﴾ maʿṭūf (conjoined) to «آمنوا». ﴿الصَّالِحاتِ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿فَهُمْ﴾ the fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa); ﴿هم﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿فِي رَوْضَةٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to what comes after them. ﴿يُحْبَرُونَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb and its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ «هم», the nominal clause is the khabar of «الذين», and the clause «أما الذين...» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:16-16.t: ﴿وَأَمَّا﴾ a particle of condition and detailing (tafṣīl). ﴿الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا﴾ a mubtadaʾ (subject), and a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is a ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَكَذَّبُوا﴾ maʿṭūf (conjoined) to «كفروا». ﴿بِآياتِنا﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb. ﴿وَلِقاءِ﴾ conjoined to «آياتنا». ﴿الْآخِرَةِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿فَأُولئِكَ﴾ the fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa); ﴿أولئك﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿فِي الْعَذابِ﴾ attached to the khabar (predicate) ﴿مُحْضَرُونَ﴾; the nominal clause is the khabar of «الذين», and the clause «أما الذين..» is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:17-17.t: ﴿فَسُبْحانَ﴾ the fāʾ is a resumptive particle; ﴿سبحان اللَّهِ﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, and the Divine Name is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿حِينَ تُمْسُونَ﴾ an adverb of time, and a complete (tāmm) imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿وَحِينَ تُصْبِحُونَ﴾ maʿṭūf (conjoined) to what precedes it.

daas-irab:18-18.t: ﴿وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ﴾ a fronted khabar (predicate) and a delayed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is parenthetical (muʿtariḍa), with no grammatical position. ﴿فِي السَّماواتِ﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَالْأَرْضِ﴾ maʿṭūf (conjoined) to «السموات». ﴿وَعَشِيًّا﴾ conjoined to «حين». ﴿وَحِينَ تُظْهِرُونَ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:19-19.t: ﴿يُخْرِجُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿الْحَيَّ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿مِنَ الْمَيِّتِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb. And ﴿يُخْرِجُ الْمَيِّتَ مِنَ الْحَيِّ﴾ is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَيُحْيِ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿الْأَرْضَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿بَعْدَ﴾ an adverb of place «[Translator's note: so in the source; «بعد» here is an adverb of time.]». ﴿مَوْتِها﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle. ﴿كَذلِكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿تُخْرَجُونَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:20-20.t: The wāw is a resumptive particle. ﴿مِنْ آياتِهِ﴾ a fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿أَنْ﴾ an infinitival and subjunctive particle. ﴿خَلَقَكُمْ﴾ a past verb; the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿مِنْ تُرابٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from «أن» and the verb is a delayed mubtadaʾ (subject), and the nominal clause is resumptive. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿إِذا﴾ of surprise (fujāʾiyya). ﴿أَنْتُمْ بَشَرٌ﴾ a mubtadaʾ and its khabar; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿تَنْتَشِرُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is a naʿt (adjective) of «بشر».

daas-irab:21-21.t:
﴿وَمِنْ آياتِهِ أَنْ خَلَقَ﴾ its i'rab has been given before.
﴿لَكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb. ﴿مِنْ أَنْفُسِكُمْ﴾ also attached to the verb. ﴿أَزْواجاً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿لِتَسْكُنُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied «أن» after the lām of causation; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from «أن» and the verb is in the position of the genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «خلق». ﴿إِلَيْها﴾ attached to the verb. ﴿وَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿جَعَلَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿بَيْنَكُمْ﴾ an adverb of place. ﴿مَوَدَّةً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَرَحْمَةً﴾ maʿṭūf (conjoined) to «مودة»; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿أَنْ﴾ a particle resembling the verb «[Translator's note: the Quranic word is «إِنَّ»; the source prints it as «أَنْ».]». ﴿فِي ذلِكَ﴾ the fronted khabar (predicate) of «إن». ﴿لَآياتٍ﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa) and the delayed noun of «إن»; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. And ﴿لِقَوْمٍ﴾ a naʿt (adjective) of «آيات». ﴿يَتَفَكَّرُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is a naʿt of «قوم».

daas-irab:22-22.t: ﴿وَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿مِنْ آياتِهِ﴾ a fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿خَلْقُ﴾ a delayed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿السَّماواتِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَالْأَرْضِ﴾ maʿṭūf (conjoined) to «السموات». ﴿وَاخْتِلافُ﴾ conjoined to «خلق». ﴿أَلْسِنَتِكُمْ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَأَلْوانِكُمْ﴾ conjoined to «ألسنتكم». ﴿إِنَّ﴾ a particle resembling the verb. ﴿فِي ذلِكَ﴾ the fronted khabar of «إن». ﴿لَآياتٍ﴾ the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); ﴿آيات﴾ the delayed noun of «إن». ﴿لِلْعالِمِينَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of «آيات»; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:23-23.t: ﴿وَمِنْ آياتِهِ﴾ a fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿مَنامُكُمْ﴾ a delayed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿بِاللَّيْلِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to what precedes them. ﴿وَالنَّهارِ﴾ maʿṭūf (conjoined) to «الليل». ﴿وَابْتِغاؤُكُمْ﴾ conjoined to «منامكم». ﴿مِنْ فَضْلِهِ﴾ attached to what precedes them. ﴿إِنَّ﴾ a particle resembling the verb. ﴿فِي ذلِكَ﴾ the fronted khabar of «إن», and the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa). ﴿لَآياتٍ﴾ the delayed noun of «إن»; the nominal clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿لِقَوْمٍ﴾ naʿt (adjective) of «آيات». ﴿يَسْمَعُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is a naʿt of «قوم».

daas-irab:24-24.t:
﴿وَمِنْ آياتِهِ﴾ a fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿يُرِيكُمُ﴾ an imperfect verb and its object; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from the implied «أن» and the verb is a delayed mubtadaʾ (subject), and the nominal clause is conjoined to what precedes it.
﴿الْبَرْقَ﴾ second mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿خَوْفاً﴾ mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). ﴿وَطَمَعاً﴾ maʿṭūf (conjoined) to «خوفا». ﴿وَيُنَزِّلُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿مِنَ السَّماءِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb. ﴿ماءً﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿فَيُحْيِي﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿بِهِ﴾ attached to the verb. ﴿الْأَرْضَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿بَعْدَ مَوْتِها﴾ an adverb of time, annexed to «موتها»; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿إِنَّ فِي ذلِكَ لَآياتٍ لِقَوْمٍ يَعْقِلُونَ﴾ the i'rab of a similar phrase has been given before.

daas-irab:3-3.t: ﴿فِي أَدْنَى﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb. ﴿الْأَرْضِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). ﴿هُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِ﴾ attached to what comes after them. ﴿غَلَبِهِمْ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿سَيَغْلِبُونَ﴾ the sīn is for the future, and an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of «هم», and the nominal clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:4-4.t: ﴿فِي بِضْعِ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb «يغلبون». ﴿سِنِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿لِلَّهِ﴾ a fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿الْأَمْرُ﴾ a delayed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلُ﴾ attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَمِنْ بَعْدُ﴾ both conjoined to what precedes them. ﴿وَ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle. ﴿يَوْمَئِذٍ﴾ «يوم» is an adverb, annexed to one like it [«إذ»]. ﴿يَفْرَحُ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:5-5.t: ﴿بِنَصْرِ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb «يفرح». ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Divine Name, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿يَنْصُرُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿مَنْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is resumptive. ﴿يَشاءُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of «من». ﴿وَ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). ﴿هُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ﴾ a mubtadaʾ (subject) and two khabars (predicates); the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:6-6.t: ﴿وَعْدَ اللَّهِ﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, and the Divine Name is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿لا﴾ negative. ﴿يُخْلِفُ﴾ an imperfect verb. ﴿اللَّهُ وَعْدَهُ﴾ the Divine Name is its fāʿil (agent), and its object; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَلكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a particle resembling the verb and its noun. ﴿النَّاسِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿لا﴾ negative. ﴿يَعْلَمُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of «لكن».

daas-irab:7-7.t: ﴿يَعْلَمُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent). ﴿ظاهِراً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿مِنَ الْحَياةِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to what precedes them. ﴿الدُّنْيا﴾ naʿt (adjective) of «الحياة». ﴿وَ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). ﴿هُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿عَنِ الْآخِرَةِ﴾ attached to the khabar (predicate) ﴿غافِلُونَ﴾. ﴿هُمْ﴾ tawkīd (emphasis) of the first; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:8-8.t: ﴿أَوَلَمْ﴾ the hamza is a particle of interrogation and the wāw is a resumptive particle. ﴿يَتَفَكَّرُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by «لم», and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive. ﴿فِي أَنْفُسِهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb. ﴿ما﴾ negative. ﴿خَلَقَ اللَّهُ﴾ a past verb, and the Divine Name is its fāʿil. ﴿السَّماواتِ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَالْأَرْضَ﴾ maʿṭūf (conjoined) to «السموات». ﴿وَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun, conjoined to «السموات». ﴿بَيْنَهُما﴾ an adverb of place. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿بِالْحَقِّ﴾ attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَأَجَلٍ﴾ conjoined to «الحق». ﴿مُسَمًّى﴾ naʿt (adjective); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَإِنَّ كَثِيراً﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and «إن» and its noun. ﴿مِنَ النَّاسِ﴾ attached to «كثيرا». ﴿بِلِقاءِ﴾ attached to «كافرون». ﴿رَبِّهِمْ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿لَكافِرُونَ﴾ the khabar (predicate) of «إن», and the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:9-9.t: ﴿أَوَلَمْ﴾ the hamza is a particle of interrogation and the wāw is a resumptive particle. ﴿لَمْ يَسِيرُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by «لم», and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent). ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb; the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَيَنْظُرُوا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿كَيْفَ﴾ an interrogative noun, in the position of the accusative as the fronted khabar (predicate) of «كان». ﴿عاقِبَةُ﴾ its delayed noun; the clause stands in place of the object of «ينظروا». ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ﴾ attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿كانُوا أَشَدَّ﴾ «كان», its noun and its khabar; the clause is explicative (tafsīriyya). ﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾ attached to «أشد». ﴿قُوَّةً﴾ tamyīz (specification). ﴿وَأَثارُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿الْأَرْضِ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object) «[Translator's note: so vowelled in the source; as object it is «الْأَرْضَ».]»; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَعَمَرُوها﴾ maʿṭūf (conjoined) to «أثاروا». ﴿أَكْثَرَ﴾ naʿt (adjective) of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿مِمَّا﴾ attached to «أكثر». ﴿عَمَرُوها﴾ a past verb with its fāʿil and its object. ﴿وَجاءَتْهُمْ﴾ a past verb and its object. ﴿رُسُلُهُمْ﴾ a delayed fāʿil. ﴿بِالْبَيِّناتِ﴾ attached to the verb; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿فَما﴾ the fāʾ is a resumptive particle; ﴿ما﴾ negative. ﴿كانَ اللَّهُ﴾ «كان», and the Divine Name is its noun. ﴿لِيَظْلِمَهُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied «أن» after the lām of denial (lām al-juḥūd); the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is in the position of the genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted khabar of «كان»; the clause «كان..» is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿لكِنْ كانُوا﴾ a particle of rectification (istidrāk), and «كان» and its noun. ﴿أَنْفُسَهُمْ﴾ a fronted mafʿūl bihi. ﴿يَظْلِمُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of «كانوا», and the clause «لكن كانوا...» is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:25-25.t: ﴿وَمِنْ آياتِهِ﴾ a fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿أَنْ تَقُومَ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by «أن»; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is a delayed mubtadaʾ (subject), and the nominal clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿السَّماءُ﴾ fāʿil (agent). ﴿وَالْأَرْضُ﴾ maʿṭūf (conjoined) to «السماء». ﴿بِأَمْرِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to «تقوم». ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿إِذا﴾ adverbial, conditional, non-jussive. ﴿دَعاكُمْ﴾ a past verb and its object, and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿دَعْوَةً﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿مِنَ الْأَرْضِ﴾ attached to «دعاكم». ﴿إِذا﴾ the [«إذا»] of surprise (fujāʾiyya). ﴿أَنْتُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿تَخْرُجُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil; the verbal clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:26-26.t: ﴿وَلَهُ﴾ a fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿مَنْ﴾ a delayed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿فِي السَّماواتِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of «من». ﴿وَالْأَرْضِ﴾ maʿṭūf (conjoined) to «السموات». ﴿كُلٌّ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿لَهُ﴾ attached to the khabar «قانتون». ﴿قانِتُونَ﴾ khabar; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:27-27.t: ﴿وَهُوَ الَّذِي﴾ a mubtadaʾ (subject) and its khabar (predicate); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it, with no grammatical position. ﴿يَبْدَؤُا﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿الْخَلْقَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is a ṣila (relative clause). ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿يُعِيدُهُ﴾ an imperfect verb and its object, and the fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَهُوَ أَهْوَنُ﴾ a mubtadaʾ and its khabar; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to «أهون». ﴿وَلَهُ﴾ a fronted khabar. ﴿الْمَثَلُ﴾ a delayed mubtadaʾ. ﴿الْأَعْلى﴾ naʿt (adjective) of «المثل»; the clause is resumptive. ﴿فِي السَّماواتِ﴾ ḥāl. ﴿وَالْأَرْضِ﴾ maʿṭūf (conjoined) to «السموات». ﴿وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ﴾ a mubtadaʾ and two khabars; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:28-28.t: ﴿ضَرَبَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb. ﴿مَثَلًا﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿مِنْ أَنْفُسِكُمْ﴾ naʿt (adjective) of «مثلا»; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿هَلْ﴾ a particle of interrogation. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ a fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿مِنْ ما﴾ attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿مَلَكَتْ أَيْمانُكُمْ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is a ṣila (relative clause). ﴿مِنْ﴾ a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. ﴿شُرَكاءَ﴾ genitive in form, nominative in position as a delayed mubtadaʾ (subject); the nominal clause explains «مثلا». ﴿فِي ما﴾ attached to a naʿt of «شركاء». ﴿رَزَقْناكُمْ﴾ a past verb with its fāʿil and its object; the clause is a ṣila. ﴿فَأَنْتُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿فِيهِ﴾ attached to the khabar ﴿سَواءٌ﴾; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿تَخافُونَهُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb with its fāʿil and its object; the clause is a second khabar of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿كَخِيفَتِكُمْ﴾ attached to an omitted naʿt of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿أَنْفُسِكُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi of «خيفتكم». ﴿كَذلِكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq. ﴿نُفَصِّلُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿الْآياتِ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿لِقَوْمٍ﴾ attached to the verb. ﴿يَعْقِلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is a naʿt of «قوم», and the clause «كذلك» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:29-29.t: ﴿بَلِ﴾ a particle of digression (iḍrāb). ﴿اتَّبَعَ الَّذِينَ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿ظَلَمُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿أَهْواءَهُمْ﴾ its object; the clause is a ṣila (relative clause). ﴿بِغَيْرِ﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿عِلْمٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿فَمَنْ﴾ the fāʾ is a resumptive particle; ﴿مَنْ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿يَهْدِي﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿مَنْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the khabar (predicate), and the nominal clause is resumptive. ﴿أَضَلَّ اللَّهُ﴾ a past verb, and the Divine Name is its fāʿil; the clause is a ṣila, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿ما﴾ negative. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ a fronted khabar. ﴿مَنْ﴾ a redundant (zāʾida) preposition «[Translator's note: the Quranic word is «مِنْ»; the source prints it as «مَنْ».]». ﴿ناصِرِينَ﴾ genitive in form, nominative in position as a delayed mubtadaʾ; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:30-30.t: ﴿فَأَقِمْ﴾ the fāʾ is a resumptive particle; ﴿فَأَقِمْ﴾ an imperative verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿وَجْهَكَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is resumptive. ﴿لِلدِّينِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb. ﴿حَنِيفاً﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿فِطْرَتَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi of an omitted verb, i.e. «اتبعوا» ("follow"). ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Divine Name, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿الَّتِي﴾ naʿt (adjective) of «فطرة». ﴿فَطَرَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿النَّاسَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the clause is a ṣila (relative clause). ﴿عَلَيْها﴾ attached to the verb. ﴿لا﴾ the lā of generic negation. ﴿تَبْدِيلَ﴾ its noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa. ﴿لِخَلْقِ﴾ attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of «لا». ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Divine Name, muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿ذلِكَ الدِّينُ﴾ a mubtadaʾ (subject) and its khabar; the clause is resumptive. ﴿الْقَيِّمُ﴾ naʿt. ﴿وَلكِنَّ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and «لكن» is a particle resembling the verb. ﴿أَكْثَرَ﴾ its noun, annexed. ﴿النَّاسَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi «[Translator's note: so vowelled in the source; as muḍāf ilayhi it is «النَّاسِ».]». ﴿لا﴾ negative. ﴿يَعْلَمُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil; the verbal clause is the khabar of «لكن», and the nominal clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:31-31.t: ﴿مُنِيبِينَ﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿إِلَيْهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to it. ﴿وَاتَّقُوهُ﴾ an imperative verb with its fāʿil (agent) and its object; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَأَقِيمُوا الصَّلاةَ﴾ an imperative verb with its fāʿil and its object; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَلا تَكُونُوا﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive «لا», and the wāw is its noun. ﴿مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ﴾ attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of «تكونوا»; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:32-32.t: ﴿مِنَ الَّذِينَ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are a badal (substitute) of His saying «من المشركين». ﴿فَرَّقُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿دِينَهُمْ﴾ its object; the clause is a ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَكانُوا﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb and its noun. ﴿شِيَعاً﴾ its khabar (predicate); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿كُلُّ حِزْبٍ﴾ a mubtadaʾ (subject), annexed to «حزب». ﴿بِما﴾ attached (mutaʿalliq) to the khabar «فرحون». ﴿لَدَيْهِمْ﴾ an adverb of place. The nominal clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿فَرِحُونَ﴾ khabar, nominative (marfūʿ) with the wāw.

daas-irab:33-33.t: The wāw is a resumptive particle. ﴿وَإِذا﴾ adverbial, conditional, non-jussive. ﴿مَسَّ النَّاسَ﴾ a past verb and its object. ﴿ضُرٌّ﴾ a delayed fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿دَعَوْا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿رَبَّهُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), with no grammatical position. ﴿مُنِيبِينَ﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿إِلَيْهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to what precedes them. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿إِذا﴾ adverbial, conditional, non-jussive. ﴿أَذاقَهُمْ﴾ a past verb and its object, and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation. ﴿مِنْهُ﴾ attached to the verb. ﴿رَحْمَةً﴾ second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿إِذا﴾ the [«إذا»] of surprise (fujāʾiyya). ﴿فَرِيقٌ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾ naʿt (adjective) of «فريق». ﴿بِرَبِّهِمْ﴾ attached to what comes after them. ﴿يُشْرِكُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil; the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:34-34.t: ﴿لِيَكْفُرُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied «أن» after the lām of causation, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from «أن» and the verb is in the position of the genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq) to «يشركون». ﴿بِما﴾ attached to the verb. ﴿آتَيْناهُمْ﴾ a past verb with its fāʿil and its object; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of «ما». ﴿فَتَمَتَّعُوا﴾ the fāʾ is the faṣīḥa [fāʾ, implying an unstated condition], and an imperative verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the apodosis (jawāb) of an implied condition, with no grammatical position. ﴿فَسَوْفَ﴾ the fāʾ is a resumptive particle; ﴿سوف﴾ a particle of the future. ﴿تَعْلَمُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:35-35.t: ﴿أَمْ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿أَنْزَلْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to «أنزل». ﴿سُلْطاناً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is resumptive, considering «أم» to mean «بل». ﴿فَهُوَ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction; ﴿هو﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿يَتَكَلَّمُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is the khabar (predicate) of «هو», and the nominal clause is conjoined to what precedes it, with no grammatical position. ﴿بِما﴾ attached to the verb. ﴿كانُوا﴾ «كان» and its noun. ﴿بِهِ﴾ attached to what comes after them. ﴿يُشْرِكُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of «كانوا», and the clause «كانوا..» is the ṣila (relative clause) of «ما».

daas-irab:36-36.t: ﴿وَإِذا﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle; ﴿إِذا﴾ adverbial, conditional, non-jussive. ﴿أَذَقْنَا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿النَّاسَ﴾ first mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿رَحْمَةً﴾ second mafʿūl bihi; the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿فَرِحُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿بِها﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb; the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), with no grammatical position. ﴿وَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿وَإِنْ تُصِبْهُمْ﴾ a conditional particle, and an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi. ﴿سَيِّئَةٌ﴾ fāʿil; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿بِما﴾ attached to the verb. ﴿قَدَّمَتْ أَيْدِيهِمْ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is a ṣila (relative clause). ﴿إِذا﴾ the [«إذا»] of surprise (fujāʾiyya). ﴿هُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿يَقْنَطُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of «هم», and the nominal clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis.

daas-irab:37-37.t: ﴿أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا﴾ the hamza is a particle of disapproving interrogation, the wāw is a resumptive particle, and an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by «لم», and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿أَنَّ اللَّهَ يَبْسُطُ﴾ «أن», and the Divine Name is its noun, and an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿الرِّزْقَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the khabar (predicate) of «أن», and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from «أن», its noun and its khabar stands in place of the two objects of «يروا». ﴿لِمَنْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb. ﴿يَشاءُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of «من». ﴿وَيَقْدِرُ﴾ maʿṭūf (conjoined) to «يبسط». ﴿إِنَّ فِي ذلِكَ لَآياتٍ لِقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ﴾: see ayah no. 22.

daas-irab:38-38.t: ﴿فَآتِ﴾ the fāʾ is the faṣīḥa [fāʾ, implying an unstated condition], and an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the weak letter, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿ذَا الْقُرْبى﴾ first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), annexed to «القربى». ﴿حَقَّهُ﴾ second mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the apodosis (jawāb) of an implied condition, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَالْمِسْكِينَ وَابْنَ السَّبِيلِ﴾ both conjoined to «ذا القربى». ﴿ذلِكَ خَيْرٌ﴾ a mubtadaʾ (subject) and its khabar (predicate); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿لِلَّذِينَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to «خير». ﴿يُرِيدُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿وَجْهَ اللَّهِ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, annexed to the Divine Name; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of «الذين», with no grammatical position. ﴿وَأُولئِكَ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿هُمُ﴾ a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl). ﴿الْمُفْلِحُونَ﴾ khabar; the nominal clause is conjoined to what precedes it, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:39-39.t: ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle; ﴿ما﴾ conditional, in the position of the accusative as a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿آتَيْتُمْ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿مِنْ رِباً﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿لِيَرْبُوَا﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied «أن» after the lām of causation; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from «أن» and what follows it is in the position of the genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «آتيتم». ﴿فِي أَمْوالِ﴾ attached to the verb. ﴿النَّاسِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿فَلا﴾ the fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa); ﴿لا يَرْبُوا﴾ «لا» is negative, and an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿عِنْدَ اللَّهِ﴾ an adverb of place, annexed to the Divine Name. ﴿وَ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle. ﴿وَما﴾ conditional, in the position of the accusative as a fronted mafʿūl bihi. ﴿آتَيْتُمْ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is initial, with no grammatical position. ﴿مِنْ زَكاةٍ﴾ ḥāl. ﴿تُرِيدُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿وَجْهَ اللَّهِ﴾ its object, annexed to the Divine Name; the clause is a naʿt (adjective) of «زكاة». ﴿فَأُولئِكَ هُمُ الْمُضْعِفُونَ﴾ the i'rab of a similar phrase has been given before.

daas-irab:40-40.t: ﴿اللَّهُ الَّذِي﴾ the Divine Name is the mubtadaʾ (subject) and the relative noun is its khabar (predicate); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿خَلَقَكُمْ﴾ a past verb and its object, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is a ṣila (relative clause). ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿رَزَقَكُمْ﴾ maʿṭūf (conjoined) to «خلقكم». ﴿ثُمَّ يُمِيتُكُمْ﴾ ﴿ثُمَّ يُحْيِيكُمْ﴾ both conjoined to what precedes them. ﴿هَلْ﴾ a particle of disapproving interrogation. ﴿مِنْ شُرَكائِكُمْ﴾ a fronted khabar. ﴿مِنْ﴾ a delayed mubtadaʾ «[Translator's note: the Quranic word is «مَنْ»; the source prints it as «مِنْ».]»; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿يَفْعَلُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the ṣila of «من». ﴿مِنْ ذلِكُمْ﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿مِنْ﴾ a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. ﴿شَيْءٍ﴾ genitive in form, accusative in position as mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿سُبْحانَهُ﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb. ﴿وَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿تَعالى﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿عَمَّا﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb before them. ﴿يُشْرِكُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is a ṣila.

daas-irab:41-41.t: ﴿ظَهَرَ الْفَسادُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿فِي الْبَرِّ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb. ﴿وَالْبَحْرِ﴾ maʿṭūf (conjoined) to «البر»; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿بِما﴾ attached to the verb «ظهر». ﴿كَسَبَتْ أَيْدِي﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿النَّاسِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of «ما». ﴿لِيُذِيقَهُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied «أن» after the lām of causation; the hāʾ is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿بَعْضَ الَّذِي﴾ second mafʿūl bihi, annexed to «الذي»; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from the implied «أن» and the verb is in the position of the genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb «ظهر». ﴿عَمِلُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is a ṣila. ﴿لَعَلَّهُمْ﴾ «لعل» and its noun. ﴿يَرْجِعُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil; the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of «لعل», and the nominal clause is causal (taʿlīl), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:42-42.t: ﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿سِيرُوا﴾ an imperative verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb. ﴿فَانْظُرُوا﴾ maʿṭūf (conjoined) to «سيروا». ﴿كَيْفَ﴾ an interrogative noun, the fronted khabar (predicate) of «كان». ﴿كانَ عاقِبَةُ الَّذِينَ﴾ «كان» and its noun, annexed to «الذين»; the clause stands in place of the two objects of «انظروا». ﴿مِنْ قَبْلُ﴾ attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿كانَ أَكْثَرُهُمْ مُشْرِكِينَ﴾ «كان», its noun and its khabar; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:43-43.t: ﴿فَأَقِمْ﴾ the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and an imperative verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿وَجْهَكَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿لِلدِّينِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb. ﴿الْقَيِّمِ﴾ naʿt (adjective) of «الدين». ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِ﴾ attached to the verb «أقم». ﴿أَنْ يَأْتِيَ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by «أن»; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿يَوْمٌ﴾ the fāʿil of «يأتي». ﴿لا﴾ the lā of generic negation. ﴿مَرَدَّ﴾ its noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa. ﴿لَهُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, the khabar (predicate) of «لا»; the clause is a naʿt of «يوم». ﴿مِنَ اللَّهِ﴾ attached to «يأتي». ﴿يَوْمَئِذٍ﴾ «يوم» is an adverb of time, annexed to one like it [«إذ»]. ﴿يَصَّدَّعُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is a second naʿt of «يوم».

daas-irab:44-44.t: ﴿مَنْ﴾ a jussive conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿كَفَرَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿فَعَلَيْهِ﴾ the fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa); ﴿عليه﴾ a fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿كُفْرُهُ﴾ a delayed mubtadaʾ; the nominal clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the two clauses of the condition and the apodosis are the khabar of the mubtadaʾ «من», and the clause «من..» is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿مَنْ﴾ a jussive conditional noun, mubtadaʾ. ﴿عَمِلَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿صالِحاً﴾ an omitted mafʿūl bihi (direct object) «[Translator's note: so in the source; presumably meaning a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted object, or simply the mafʿūl bihi.]». ﴿فَلِأَنْفُسِهِمْ﴾ the fāʾ is connective; ﴿لأنفسهم﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to what comes after them. ﴿يَمْهَدُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the apodosis, and the two clauses of the condition and the apodosis are the khabar of the mubtadaʾ «من», and the clause «من..» is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:45-45.t: ﴿لِيَجْزِيَ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied «أن» after the lām of causation, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from «أن» and the verb is in the position of the genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb «يمهدون». ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of «الذين». ﴿وَعَمِلُوا﴾ maʿṭūf (conjoined) to «آمنوا». ﴿الصَّالِحاتِ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مِنْ فَضْلِهِ﴾ attached to the verb «يجزي». ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾ «إن» and its noun. ﴿لا﴾ negative. ﴿يُحِبُّ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿الْكافِرِينَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of «إن», and the nominal clause is causal (taʿlīl), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:46-46.t: ﴿وَمِنْ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle; ﴿مِنْ آياتِهِ﴾ a fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿أَنْ يُرْسِلَ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by «أن», and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿الرِّياحَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿مُبَشِّراتٍ﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial); the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from «أن» and the verb is a delayed mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَلِيُذِيقَكُمْ﴾ a conjunction, and an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied «أن» after the lām of causation; the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi and the fāʿil is latent. ﴿مِنْ رَحْمَتِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb; the interpreted maṣdar formed from «أن» and the verb is in the position of the genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted [verb], its implied form being «أرسلها» ("He sent them"). ﴿وَلِتَجْرِيَ﴾ a conjunction, and an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied «أن» after the lām of causation. ﴿الْفُلْكُ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿بِأَمْرِهِ﴾ ḥāl; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَلِتَبْتَغُوا مِنْ فَضْلِهِ﴾ maʿṭūf (conjoined) to what precedes it. ﴿وَلَعَلَّكُمْ﴾ a conjunction, and «لعل» and its noun. ﴿تَشْكُرُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil; the verbal clause is the khabar of «لعل», and the nominal clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

farraa:2-3.t:
His saying: ﴿غُلِبَتِ ٱلرُّومُ﴾: The readers agree on ﴿غُلِبَت﴾, except Ibn ʿUmar, who read it (غَلَبَتِ الرُّومُ) ("the Romans have conquered"). It was said to him: over what [143] did they prevail? He said: over the nearest countryside of Syria. The exegesis rejects the view of Ibn ʿUmar. That is because Persia triumphed over the Romans, and the Muslims were saddened by that, while the idolaters of Mecca rejoiced, because the Persians worshipped idols and had no scripture, so the idolaters loved them for that; and the Muslims inclined towards the Romans because they were people of scripture and prophethood. The evidence for that is the saying of Allah: ﴿وَهُم مِّن بَعْدِ غَلَبِهِمْ سَيَغْلِبُونَ﴾, and then He said after that: and on the day they prevail the believers will rejoice, when they prevail. And all of that came to pass.
His saying: ﴿مِّن بَعْدِ غَلَبِهِمْ﴾: the speech of the Arabs is ghalabtuhu ghalabatan; when they annex it they drop the hāʾ [i.e. the tāʾ marbūṭa], as they dropped it in His saying ﴿وإقام الصَّلاةِ﴾, while the [usual] speech is iqāmat al-ṣalāt.

farraa:4-4.t:
His saying: ﴿لِلَّهِ ٱلأَمْرُ مِن قَبْلُ وَمِن بَعْدُ﴾: The reading is with the nominative [ḍamma] without tanwīn, because in meaning both are intended to be annexed to something, inevitably. When they conveyed the meaning of what they are annexed to, they marked them with the nominative while they are [in position] genitive, so that the nominative would be an indication of what has been dropped of that to which you annexed them. The same applies to what resembles them, as in the poet's saying:
* إن تأتِ من تحتُ أجِئْها من عَلُ *
(If you come at it from below, I will come at it from above.)
And similar is the poet's saying:
إذا أنا لم أُومَن عَليكِ ولم يَكُن * لقاؤكِ إلاَّ من ورَاءُ ورَاءُ
(If I am not trusted with you, and meeting you is only from behind, behind…)
You put it in the nominative when you make it a ghāya (an "end-word", whose annexed complement is cut off) and do not mention after it what you annexed it to. If you intend to make it overt, or you do make it overt, you say: "lillāhi al-amru min qabli wa-min baʿdi", as though you had made overt the genitive to which you attached (قَبْل) and (بعد). Al-Kisāʾī heard one of Banū Asad read it (لِلَّهِ ٱلأَمْرُ مِن قَبْلِ وَمِن بَعْدُ), putting (قبل) in the genitive and (بَعد) in the nominative, according to what he intended. And he — meaning al-Kisāʾī — recited to me:
أكابِدهَا حَتى أُعَرِّسَ بَعْد مَا * يكون سُحُيْراً أو بُعَيدَ فأهْجَعَا
(I struggle with it until I halt to rest after it is just before dawn, or a little after, and then I sleep.)
He meant "a little after dawn" (buʿayda al-saḥar) and left it implied. Had he not intended the implied annexation, he would have used the nominative and said buʿaydu. Similar is the poet's saying:
لَعَمْركَ ما أدرى وإنى لأَوجَلُ * على أيِّنا تَعْدو المنيَّةُ أوّلُ
(By your life, I do not know — and I am afraid — on which of us death will fall first.)
You put (أوّل) in the nominative because it is a ghāya; do you not see that it is attached to something of which it is the first? Just as you know that (قبل) can only be before something, and that (بعد) is likewise. And had you set them free in Arabic and given them tanwīn while they carry the meaning of annexation — putting them in the genitive [with tanwīn] in the genitive, and with tanwīn in the accusative and nominative — it would be correct; that has been heard from the Arabs and has come in their poetry. One of them said:
وساغَ لى الشرابُ وكنت قبلاً * أكاد أغَصُّ بالمَاء الحمِيم
(Drink became pleasant to me, while before I nearly choked on warm water.)
He used tanwīn. Likewise you say: "I came to you before (min qablin) and saw you." Likewise his saying:
مِكَرٍّ مِفَرٍّ مقبل مُدبرٍ معاً * كجُلمودِ صخرٍ حطّه السيلُ من عَلِ
(Wheeling, fleeing, advancing, retreating all at once, like a boulder the torrent has sent down from on high.)
This is genitive; if you wish you may use tanwīn, and if you wish you may not use tanwīn, according to your intention. Another said, in the nominative:
كَأنّ مِحَطّا فى يدَى حارثيَّةٍ * صَنَاعٍ علت منّى به الجِلدَ من عَلُ
(As though a tattooing needle in the hands of a skilful woman of Banū al-Ḥārith had gone over my skin with it from above.)
Al-miḥaṭṭ is a needle with which she tattoos her hand.
As for the saying of the other:
هتكت به بيوتَ بنى طَرِيفٍ * على ما كان قبلٌ من عِتاب
(With it I tore open the tents of Banū Ṭarīf, for the reproach there had been before.)
where he used tanwīn and the nominative, that is due to poetic necessity, just as the poet is forced to use tanwīn in the single vocative and says "yā Zaydun, come forward!" He said:
قدَّمُوا إذْ قيل قيسٌ قدِّمُوا * وارفعُوا المجدَ بأطرافِ الأَسَل
(They advanced when it was said: "Qays, advance! and raise glory on the tips of the spears.")
And one of Banū ʿUqayl recited to me:
ونحن قتلنا الأَسْدَ أَسْدَ شَنُوءَة * فما شرِبُوا بعدٌ عَلَى لذَّة خمرَا
(We killed al-Asd, the Asd of Shanūʾa, and after that they never drank wine with pleasure.)
Had he turned it back to the accusative when he used tanwīn, that would be a valid way, as he said:
وسَاغ لى الشراب وكنت قبلاً * أكاد أغَصَّ بالمََـَاء الحَمِيم
(Drink became pleasant to me, while before I nearly choked on warm water.)
Likewise in the vocative: had the accusative been restored when tanwīn is used in it, that would be a valid way, as he said:
فطِر خالداً إن كنتَ تَسْطيع طَيْرةً * وَلا تَقَعْن إلاَّ وقلبُـكَ حَاذِِر
(Fly, Khālid, if you can manage a flight, and do not land except with your heart on its guard.)
And do not reject annexing qabl, baʿd and the like even when [the second element] is not overt, for he said:
إِلاَّ بُدَاهةَ أو عُلاَلَة * سَابحٍ نَهْدِ الجُزَاره
(Except the first burst or the second run of a swift-galloping horse with stout limbs.)
And another said:
يامن يرى عَرِضاً أكفكفُهُ * بين ذِرَاعىْ وجَبْهةِ الأَسَدِ
(O who sees a cloud I keep watching, between the Forearms and the Forehead of the Lion [constellation]?)
I heard Abū Tharwān al-ʿUklī say: "May Allah this morning cut off the hand and foot of whoever said it" (yada wa-rijla man qālahu). This is permissible only with two things that accompany each other, like the hand and the foot, and like saying "I have half or a quarter of a dirham" and "I came to you before or after the afternoon prayer". It is not permissible with two things that are far apart, like the house and the slave-boy: do not allow "I bought the house or the slave-boy of Zayd"; but [you may say] "the slave or the slave-woman of Zayd", "an eye or an ear", "a hand or a foot", and the like.

farraa:7-7.t: His saying: ﴿يَعْلَمُونَ ظَاهِراً مِّنَ ٱلْحَيَاةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا﴾ means the people of Mecca. He says: they know trade and livelihood, and He made that their knowledge; but as for the affair of the Hereafter, they are blind.

farraa:8-8.t: His saying: ﴿إِلاَّ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَأَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى﴾: he says: We did not create them ﴿إِلاَّ بِٱلْحَقِّ﴾ — for reward, punishment and deeds — ﴿وَأَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى﴾: the Resurrection.

farraa:9-9.t: His saying: ﴿وَأَثَارُواْ ٱلأَرْضَ﴾: they ploughed it, ﴿وَعَمَرُوهَآ أَكْثَرَ﴾ than they [the Meccans] cultivate it. He says: they used to cultivate more than the people of Mecca cultivate, and they were destroyed.

farraa:10-10.t:
His saying: ﴿ثُمَّ كَانَ عَاقِبَةَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسَاءُواْ ٱلسُّوۤءَىٰ﴾.
You put "the outcome" in the accusative by kāna, and make the nominative of (كان) be in ﴿ٱلسُّوۤءَىٰ﴾. Had you put "the outcome" in the nominative and ﴿ٱلسُّوۤءَىٰ﴾ in the accusative, it would be correct. ﴿ٱلسُّوۤءَىٰ﴾ in this place is the punishment; it is also said: the Fire.
His saying ﴿أَن كَذَّبُواْ﴾: for their denial, and because (li-an) they denied; when you drop the lām it is accusative.

farraa:12-12.t:
His saying: ﴿يُبْلِسُ ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ﴾: they despair of all good, and their speech and their arguments are cut off. Abū ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Sulamī read (يُبْلَسُ ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ) with fatḥa on the lām. The first is better. The poet said:
يا صَاحِ هل تعرف رَسماً مكرَساً * قال نعم أعرفُه وَأبلسَا
(O friend, do you recognise a trace caked with dung? He said: yes, I know it — and fell silent in despair.)

farraa:17-17.t: His saying: ﴿فَسُبْحَانَ ٱللَّهِ حِينَ تُمْسُونَ﴾: he says: pray to Allah ﴿حِينَ تُمْسُونَ﴾, which is the sunset and night prayers; ﴿وَحِينَ تُصْبِحُونَ﴾: the dawn prayer; ﴿وَعَشِيّاً﴾: the afternoon prayer; ﴿وَحِينَ تُظْهِرُونَ﴾: the noon prayer.

farraa:22-22.t: His saying: ﴿لآيَاتٍ لِّلْعَالَمِينَ﴾: He means the worlds of jinn and humans. Whoever reads it ﴿للعَالِمينَ﴾ ("for those who know"), that is a good reading, because He has said ﴿لآياتٍ لقومٍ يَعْقِلُونَ﴾ and ﴿لآياتٍ لأُولِى الأَلْبَابِ﴾.

farraa:24-24.t:
His saying: ﴿وَمِنْ آيَاتِهِ يُرِيكُمُ ٱلْبَرْقَ خَوْفاً﴾: before it and after it there is (أنْ … أنْ), and each is correct. Whoever makes (أنْ) overt, it is in the position of a nominative noun, as He said ﴿وَمِنْ آيَاتِهِ مَنَامُكُمْ بِاللَّيِْلِ والنَّهَارِ﴾. When you omit (أنْ), you make (مِن) stand for an omitted noun of which the verb is the ṣila, as in the poet's saying:
وما الدهر إِلاَّ تارتان فمنهُمَا * أمُوتُ وَأُخرى أبتغى العَيْش أكدح
(Time is but two turns: in one of them I die, and in the other I seek a living, toiling.)
[144/b] / As though he meant: of them is a time in which I die, and a time in which I live. Likewise: of His signs is a sign for the lightning and a sign for such-and-such. And if you wish: He shows you, of His signs, the lightning — without implying (أن) or anything else.

farraa:25-25.t: His saying: ﴿أَن تَقُومَ ٱلسَّمَآءُ وَٱلأَرْضُ بِأَمْرِهِ﴾: he says: that they continue standing by His command without pillars.

farraa:27-27.t: His saying: ﴿وَهُوَ أَهْوَنُ عَلَيْهِ﴾: Abū al-ʿAbbās related to us: Muḥammad related to us: al-Farrāʾ related to us, saying: al-Ḥasan ibn ʿUmāra related from al-Ḥakam from Mujāhid that he said: re-creating is easier for Him than originating. Abū Zakariyyāʾ [al-Farrāʾ] said: I do not care for that. What is to be said about it is that it is a parable Allah struck, saying: do you disbelieve in the resurrection? The original creation of you from nothing is harder; so re-creating from something ought, in your view, O people of disbelief, to be easier for Him. Then He said ﴿وَلَهُ ٱلْمَثَلُ ٱلأَعْلَىٰ﴾, and this is a witness that it is a parable Allah struck. Abū al-ʿAbbās related to us, saying: Muḥammad related to us, saying: al-Farrāʾ related to us, saying: Ḥibbān related to me from al-Kalbī from Abū Ṣāliḥ from Ibn ʿAbbās, who said: ﴿وَهُوَ أَهْوَنُ عَلَيْهِ﴾: [easier] for the created being, because He will say to him on the Day of Resurrection "Be!" and he will be, whereas the beginning of his creation was a drop of semen, then from a clinging clot, then from a lump of flesh.

farraa:28-28.t: His saying: ﴿كَخِيفَتِكُمْ أَنفُسَكُمْ﴾: You put "selves" in the accusative because the interpretation of the kāf and mīm in ﴿خِيفَتِكُمْ﴾ is nominative [i.e. they are the agent of the maṣdar]. If you intended it — the kāf and mīm — to be in the interpretation of an accusative, you would put what follows in the nominative. You say in ordinary speech: "I wondered at abundant water-drinking's agreeing with you (min muwāfaqatika kathratu shurbi al-māʾ)" [with the following noun nominative], and "I wondered at your buying a slave you do not need" [with it accusative]. When the like of this occurs in speech, treat it according to the meaning, not according to the wording. The Arabs say: "I wondered at your standing, all of you (ajmaʿūna and ajmaʿīna)", and "your standing, all of you (kullukum and kullikum)": whoever uses the genitive makes it follow the wording, because it is genitive on the surface, and whoever uses the nominative goes by the interpretation. Similar is ﴿لإيلاَفِ قرَيْشٍ إيلاَفِهِمْ رِحْلَةَ الشِّتَاء والصَّيْفِ﴾: you made the action of Quraysh fall upon ﴿رِحْلَة﴾. And the Arabs say: "I wondered at their falling one upon another (baʿḍuhā fawqa baʿḍin)" and "baʿḍihā", in the same way; this is when they use a pronoun. But when they say "I heard the grinding of his canines, one against another (baʿḍihā baʿḍan)", they put (بعض) in the genitive, and that is the proper way in speech, because what precedes it is an overt noun, so they made it follow it. Had you put (بعضهَا) in the nominative, it would be according to the interpretation.

farraa:30-30.t: His saying: ﴿فِطْرَتَ ٱللَّهِ﴾: He means the religion of Allah; it is accusative by a verb, like His saying ﴿صِبْغَةَ اللهِِ﴾. His saying ﴿ٱلَّتِي فَطَرَ ٱلنَّاسَ عَلَيْهَا﴾: he says: the newborn is upon the natural disposition (al-fiṭra) until his two parents are the ones who make him a Christian or make him a Jew. It is also said: the fiṭra of Allah is that Allah created the servants on this: on their knowing that they have a Lord and a Disposer.

farraa:31-31.t:
His saying: ﴿مُنِيبِينَ﴾ is accusative by a verb, or, if you wish, by severance (qaṭʿ, as a ḥāl):
"So set your face, you and those with you, turning in repentance (munībīn)", turning towards Him.
His saying: ﴿وَلاَ تَكُونُواْ مِنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ﴾ ﴿مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ فَارَقُواْ دِينَهُمْ﴾: this is one way. And if you wish you may begin anew and say: ﴿مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ فَارَقُواْ دِينَهُمْ وَكَانُواْ شِيَعاً كُلُّ حِزْبٍ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ فَرِحُونَ﴾, as though you said: of those who split up and formed factions, each party is rejoicing in what is in its hand.

farraa:35-35.t: His saying: ﴿أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ سُلْطَاناً﴾: a book, which commands them to worship idols and to associate partners [with Allah].

farraa:39-39.t:
His saying: ﴿لِّيَرْبُوَ﴾: ʿĀṣim, al-Aʿmash and Yaḥyā ibn Waththāb read it with the yāʾ and the wāw in the accusative. The people of the Hijaz read it ﴿لِتُرْبُوَ﴾ [Translator's note: so vowelled in the source; the form intended is li-turbū], "you". All are correct. Whoever reads ﴿ليَرْبوَ﴾, the verb belongs to the usury; whoever says ﴿لتُرْبُوا﴾, the verb belongs to the people addressed, and the dropping of the nūn indicates its accusative. Its meaning is: whatever you give of anything in order to take more than it, that is not growing with Allah; ﴿وَمَآ آتَيْتُمْ مِّن زَكَاةٍ تُرِيدُونَ﴾ by it ﴿وَجْهَ ٱللَّهِ﴾ — that grows by being multiplied.
His saying: ﴿هُمُ ٱلْمُضْعِفُونَ﴾: people entitled to multiplication, just as the Arabs say "aṣbaḥtum musminīna, muʿṭishīna" when [your animals] have become thirsty or fat. Al-Kisāʾī heard the Arabs say: "aṣbaḥta muqwiyan", i.e. your camels are strong, and "aṣbaḥta muḍʿifan", i.e. your camels are ḍiʿāf — meaning weak, from al-ḍuʿf (weakness).

farraa:41-41.t: His saying: ﴿ظَهَرَ ٱلْفَسَادُ فِي ٱلْبَرِّ وَٱلْبَحْرِ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ أَيْدِي ٱلنَّاسِ لِيُذِيقَهُمْ﴾: he says: the land became barren and the supply of the sea was cut off because of their sins; and that was so that they might be made to taste hardship for their sins in this present life.

farraa:43-43.t: His saying: ﴿يَصَّدَّعُونَ﴾: they will be split apart. He said: I heard the Arabs say: "I split my sheep into two groups (ṣadaʿtu ghanamī ṣidʿatayn)", like your saying: I divided them into two divisions.

farraa:50-50.t: His saying: ﴿إِلَىٰ آثَارِ رَحْمَتِ ٱللَّهِ﴾: ʿĀṣim and al-Aʿmash read it (آثَارِ), and the people of the Hijaz (أَثَر); all are correct.

farraa:51-51.t: His saying: ﴿فَرَأَوْهُ مُصْفَرّاً﴾: they fear its perishing after its greenness — he means the crops.

farraa:53-53.t: His saying: ﴿بِهَادِ ٱلْعُمْيِ عَن ضَلاَلَتِهِمْ﴾ and ﴿من ضَلاَلَتِهِمْ﴾: each is correct. Whoever says ﴿عَن ضَلاَلَتِهِمْ﴾, it is as though he said: you cannot turn the blind away from error; and whoever says (مِنْ) says: you cannot hold them back from error.

farraa:55-55.t: His saying: ﴿يُقْسِمُ ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ مَا لَبِثُواْ غَيْرَ سَاعَةٍ﴾: they swear, when they come forth, that they remained in their graves only an hour. Allah said: they lied in this, as they lied in the world and denied. Had it been "we did not remain (mā labithnā) but an hour", it would be a valid way, because it is their own speech, as in your saying in ordinary speech: "they swore they did not stand (mā qāmū)" and "they swore: we did not stand (mā qumnā)".

muyesser-irab:1-1.t: ﴿الم﴾: the discussion of the disjointed letters (al-ḥurūf al-muqaṭṭaʿa) has preceded at the beginning of Sūrat al-Baqara.

muyesser-irab:2-2.t: ﴿غلبت الروم﴾: غلبت: a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive); and الروم: nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).

muyesser-irab:3-3.t: ﴿في أدنى الأرض وهم من بعد غلبهم سيغلبون﴾: في أدنى: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) غلبت; the wāw: a conjunction; هم: mubtadaʾ (subject); من بعد: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to His saying سيغلبون; غلبهم: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and it [the maṣdar] has been annexed to its object; and the clause سيغلبون: the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ.

muyesser-irab:4-4.t:
﴿في بضع سنين لله الأمر من قبل ومن بعد﴾: في بضع سنين: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) His saying ﴿سيغلبون﴾; لله: fronted khabar (predicate); الأمر: postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); من قبل: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); من: a preposition; قبل and بعد: two adverbs made indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma because they are cut off from annexation in wording but not in meaning; they were then put in the genitive by من and remained on their ḍamma.
﴿ويومئذ يفرح المؤمنون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿يومئذ﴾: يوم: an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān) attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يفرح﴾; إذٍ: a noun indeclinable (mabnī) on an implied sukūn, because the place is occupied by the tanwīn of compensation, in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the tanwīn compensates for a clause, the implied form being: "and on the day when the Romans overcome Persia the believers will rejoice." ﴿يفرح﴾ is an imperfect verb, and ﴿المؤمنون﴾ is the fāʿil (agent).

muyesser-irab:5-5.t: ﴿بنصر الله ينصر من يشاء وهو العزيز الرحيم﴾: بنصر: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) يفرح, and the Name of Majesty is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); ينصر: an imperfect verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun; من: a relative noun, the object of ينصر; the clause يشاء: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; the wāw is a conjunction; هو: mubtadaʾ (subject); العزيز: first khabar (predicate); and الرحيم: second khabar.

muyesser-irab:6-6.t: ﴿وعد الله لا يخلف الله وعده ولكن أكثر الناس لا يعلمون﴾: وعد: a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) whose governing verb is implied, the implied form being "Allah promised them that as a promise"; لا: negating; ﴿يخلف الله وعده﴾: a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the pronoun is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the wāw: circumstantial (ḥāliyya); ﴿لكنَّ أكثر﴾: لكن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), and أكثر is its noun; الناس: muḍāf ilayhi; and the clause ﴿لا يعلمون﴾: the khabar (predicate) of لكِنَّ.

muyesser-irab:7-7.t: ﴿يعلمون ظاهرا من الحياة الدنيا وهم عن الآخرة هم غافلون﴾: يعلمون ظاهرا: a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); من الحياة الدنيا: a preposition, its genitive noun and a naʿt (adjective); the clause ﴿يعلمون﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position; هم: mubtadaʾ (subject); عن الآخرة: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) غافلون; the second ﴿هم﴾: a tawkīd (emphasis) of the first ﴿هم﴾; and غافلون: the khabar (predicate) of the first ﴿هم﴾. Or the second ﴿هم﴾ is a mubtadaʾ and ﴿غافلون﴾ a khabar of the second ﴿هم﴾, the clause ﴿هم غافلون﴾ being a khabar of the first ﴿هم﴾.

muyesser-irab:8-8.t:
﴿أولم يتفكروا في أنفسهم ما خلق الله السماوات والأرض وما بينهما إلا بالحق وأجل مسمى﴾: the hamza: for disapproving interrogation (istifhām inkārī); the wāw: conjoining to something implied which the context requires; لم: a particle of negation, inversion (qalb) and jussive; يتفكروا: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by ﴿لم﴾, and the wāw of the plural: fāʿil (agent); في أنفسهم: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يتفكروا﴾. ما: negating; خلق الله السماوات: a verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the wāw is a conjunction; ما: a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi; بينهما: an adverb (ẓarf) attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position; the pronoun is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); إلا: a particle of restriction; بالحق: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil of خلق; أجل: conjoined to الحق; and مسمى: a naʿt (adjective) of أجل.
﴿وإن كثيرا من الناس بلقاء ربهم لكافرون﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); إن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), and كثيرا is its noun; من الناس: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of كثيرًا; بلقاء: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to كافرون; ربهم: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the lām: the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); and كافرون: the khabar (predicate) of إن.

muyesser-irab:9-9.t:
﴿أولم يسيروا في الأرض فينظروا كيف كان عاقبة الذين من قبلهم﴾: the hamza is for disapproving interrogation (istifhām inkārī); the wāw: conjoining to something implied which the context requires, i.e. "did they stay sitting in their places and not travel?"; لم: a particle of negation, inversion (qalb) and jussive; يسيروا: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لم, and the wāw: fāʿil (agent); في الأرض: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) يسيروا; فينظروا: the fāʾ conjoins to يسيروا, or the fāʾ is causal (sababiyya), and ينظروا is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by أن concealed after the fāʾ, the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from the concealed ﴿أن﴾ and the verb being conjoined to a maṣdar taken from the preceding speech, its implied form being: "was there not a travelling and then a looking?"; كيف: an interrogative noun in the position of accusative as the fronted khabar (predicate) of كان; عاقبة: its noun; الذين: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); من قبلهم: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position; and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi.
